Posted in #coastal-team for you: the Saltmarsh Provisions discount in the channel is 10%.

Bettina first posted 12% on Nov 17, 2025, then retracted it four minutes later and corrected it to 10%, saying she had misread June Osei-Lark's draft worksheet. The channel never shows a signed order form or June confirming the figure, so check the final order form or ask June before the renewal brief goes out.
